Coram : R.F. NARIMAN*, S. RAVINDRA BHAT
Motor Vehicles Act, 1988: s.166 – Comprehensive Private Car ‘B’ Policy – Fatal accident – A surgeon working in respondent no.3 hospital was travelling in a bus owned by the hospital which met with an accident due to rash and driver of the bus – The surgeon was seriously injured and ultimately succumbed to his injuries – Claim for compensation by his wife – The policy contained a clause that the insurance company would not be liable where death or injury arose out of and in the course of employment of
